brace-expansion is a transitive dependency; the only fixed release (5.0.8) is in the 5.x major line, with no backport to the 1.x line, which ends at 1.1.17. Waiting for upstream to provide a fix for the 1.x line.

OpenSearch Dashboards core yarn.lock pins brace-expansion across 1.x, 2.x, and 5.x concurrently. Upgrading 1.x copies to the fixed version 5.0.8 is a major version jump that previously broke minimatch during bootstrap. Plugin-only trees that carry brace-expansion 5.x are bumped to 5.0.8 via yarn/bump instead.

brace-expansion 5.0.5 is bundled inside the DHI npm package used by sbx-templates for Node-based agent tooling. A fixed brace-expansion release exists, but the image cannot safely replace npm internals in place; waiting for the npm package to consume the fixed dependency.
